jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
Job Description

Biology is the most powerful technology on the planet. It can feed the world, replace petrochemicals, and grow materials we currently mine or refine. The problem is that turning a promising organism into a working production process still takes 5+ years and millions of dollars, and half the time it fails anyway, not because the biology was wrong, but because making biology viable as a product at commercial scale with current tools is a monumental task.

Reshape builds the operating system for biotech R&D: hardware, software and data science products that capture, structure and analyze data to enable R&D and QC workflows to be much more effective. Hyperscale is our newest and most ambitious bet inside that mission - a full biological engineering suite that takes a product from 96-well plate to full production scale 10x faster and cheaper compared to traditional bioprocess development.

We're building this from the ground up, in-house, in our Copenhagen lab: our own bioreactor fleet across scales, our own data capture layer, and partnering with impressive companies for real strains and processes to prove the whole thing works.

Job requirements

You will build the strain-characterization and analytical foundation in the Hyperscale program. This is a generalist role, spanning a wide range of responsibilities related to strain engineering and characterization, analytics and support bioprocess development. That means building and characterizing microbial strains and analytical methods that explain—and ultimately predict—fermentation performance across scales.. You’ll be troubleshooting them when they misbehave, and helping us get the data needed to understand exactly what is happening in our fermentations.

What You Will Do

Establish reproducible strain-characterization and assay workflows.
Build a reference dataset connecting genotype and phenotype with fermentation performance.
Diagnose at least one important strain-related cause of poor scale transfer.
Deliver characterized strains, methods, and data packages that fermentation and modelling teams can use directly.
Collaborate with hardware and software teams to improve experimental automation, data capture, and analytical workflows.
Contribute to partner projects involving real organisms, processes, and scale-up challenges.

You'll be shaping what "strain characterization for upscaling" means at Reshape as much as executing it hands-on in the lab. You'll work in a close daily loop with a team spanning fermentation science, bioengineering, hardware engineering and data science, spending a significant amount of your time in our 500 m2 lab in Østerbro.

At a Glance

Analytics and assays: Support fermentation team with assay development and execution, feeding valuable data points and interpretations across studies.
Root-cause analysis and interpretation: Study, interpret and analyse the hypotheses for why fermentations fail or underperform across scales in collaboration with the team using the data generated.
Strain building and troubleshooting: Acquire, construct, modify, and troubleshoot production host organisms, often in collaboration with partners.
Generalist science and lab ops: We cover a broad range of disciplines with a small team. Helping out across anything that needs to be done in-lab will be key.
Cross-functional core: Partner daily with the broader science team and our hardware/software teams to close the loop between strain, process, and data capture.

Job responsibilities

Someone with a molecular biology or bioengineering background who wants to build technology that will let bioprocess upscaling 10x cheaper and faster. You've built, modified, and analyzed complex processes and strains before and you're comfortable navigating a broad set of problems.

You're an experimentalist who wants to build something from scratch — acquiring & engineering organisms, designing studies, and creating an analytics layer that doesn't fully exist yet — rather than executing an established protocol handed down from someone else. You get excited both about developing methods, but also about getting hands-on in the lab. You think of root causes and think from first principles. You're comfortable with ambiguity, curious and optimistic.

What you bring

A molecular biology background with hands-on experience building, engineering, or troubleshooting strains and metabolism.
Familiarity with biochemical analyses, -omics analysis and characterization tools; genomics depth is a plus but not required.
The ability to design controlled experiments, analyze complex datasets, and draw sound conclusions from imperfect or unexpected results.
Experimental rigor and a root-cause mindset — you question why and exactly how something failed rather than just documenting that it did.
Comfort designing your own studies and protocols in an early-stage lab without a mature toolchain.
Self-driven and collaborative; comfortable in a fast-moving startup with no inherited org chart for this program.

Useful Additional Experience

An understanding of microbial physiology and how strain characteristics influence cultivation and fermentation performance.
Analytical techniques for biomass, metabolites, substrates, or fermentation products.
Design of experiments, multivariate analysis, or statistical modelling, Python, R, JMP, or comparable analytical tools.
Building laboratory workflows in a startup or similarly fast-moving R&D environment.

Job benefits

At Reshape, we’ve built the full stack - hardware, software and data science capabilities, applied aggressively to bioengineering problems. We manufacture in-house and service more than a hundred customers globally from our office in Copenhagen, and we’re investing aggressively to keep expanding our platform capabilities and technology stack. This is the chance to join that build-out and become part of a highly ambitious and skilled team with an optimism about what is possible in biotechnology. You will be given responsibility, freedom and resources to achieve goals within the team and have a big influence on what gets built, working from our own 500m2 lab in the heart of Østerbro.

We’re not working to upscale any particular product, but to change the way upscaling and bioproduction is done. If you want to be part of building technology to enable upscaling to be fast, cheap, and predictable, please apply.

You'll play a key role in establishing best practices for product analytics, event tracking, and experimentation while enabling teams to make confident, data-informed decisions.

Your insights will directly influence the experience of millions of consumers and thousands of professionals using Bokadirekt every month.

Beyond product analytics, we're looking for someone with an AI-native mindset—someone who knows how to leverage AI to work smarter while applying sound judgement to validate AI-generated insights and recommendations. What You'll Do

Drive product insights across the full customer journey by identifying user behaviour, friction points, drop-offs, and growth opportunities
Own A/B testing end-to-end, from experiment design and statistical validation to analysis and post-mortems
Champion our experimentation framework by coaching product managers, designers, and engineers on experiment design and data-informed decision-making
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define, implement, and continuously improve reliable event tracking standards
Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and apply sound judgement when validating AI-generated insights

Who You Are

jobs.title: Data Analyst Student
jobs.description:
Læger uden Grænser søger Data Analyst studentermedhjælper

Læger uden Grænser arbejder i mere end 70 lande over hele verden, hvor vi sikrer akut medicinsk nødhjælp til mennesker i krigs- og katastrofeområder.
Vi leder lige nu efter en studentermedhjælper til vores danske kontor. Du skal være med til at sikre, at vi får de bedst mulige resultater af vores fundraisingkampagner, så vi kan sende så mange penge som muligt til det vigtige nødhjælpsarbejde, vores læger og sygeplejersker udfører i felten.
I tæt samarbejde med vores data analyst kommer du til at arbejde med analyse, KPI-rapportering og udvikling og vedligeholdelse af dashboards i Microsoft Power BI. Du vil også arbejde med vores dataplatform, som er en Microsoft Fabric-løsning. Dine kolleger vil være fundraiserne i afdelingen og vores Fundraising Tech & Data team.
Det er et strategisk fokus for os at arbejde data driven for at opnå det bedst mulige resultat af vores fundraisingindsats, og vi tager løbende nye værktøjer i brug, herunder AI og machine learning.
Vi arbejder med store datamængder, har store ambitioner og er et lille team, så jobbet giver gode muligheder for at få indflydelse på løsningerne og gøre en forskel.
DIne ansvarsområder og opgaver:

Sammen med vores dataanalyseteam skal du:
Vedligeholde og videreudvikle vores dataanalyse-setup og vores Power BI-løsning
Udføre dataselektioner fra vores CRM og dataplatform til vores fundraisingkampagner
Udvikle dataprocesser der mindsker manuelt arbejde og menneskelige fejl
Udarbejde adhoc analyser af komplekse data
Identificere nye muligheder ved hjælp af AI og Machine Learning

Det forventes ikke, at du på egen hånd kan alt på listen, men du skal have viljen og interessen for området og gerne basis-kompetencer.
Kvalifikationer og personlige kompetencer:

Du studerer Data Science, Business Analytics eller lignende og er et par år inde i studiet
Du har minimum 1,5 år tilbage på studiet
Du tænker analytisk og har en stærk dataforståelse
Du har erfaring med SQL og Python el.lign. og gerne PowerBI eller Tableau
Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til Microsoft Fabric eller anden dataplatform
Du er god til at formidle analyser og resultater mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk (og gerne engelsk)
Du er selvstændig, resultatorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst
Du brænder for at arbejde for en international nødhjælpsorganisation, hvor du kan bruge din teoretiske viden til at gøre en reel forskel for en masse mennesker.

Vi tilbyder:

Udfordringer, ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder.
Et studiejob, der giver dig fleksibilitet i forhold til, hvordan du bedst tilrettelægger din arbejdstid og dine opgaver, og hvor vi tager hensyn til dit skema og dine eksamener.
Et job med en masse variation i opgaverne.
Et godt kollegialt og fagligt samarbejde i fundraisingafdelingen og på tværs af kontoret
At du bliver en del af en organisation i en spændende udvikling i Danmark og med mulighed for samarbejde på tværs af Læger uden Grænsers kontorer i Norden og globalt.
En arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel og arbejdsglæde har høj prioritet, samtidig med at vi knokler for at levere de bedst mulige resultater til gavn for patienterne.

Du vil referere til vores CRM & Data Manager, Tina Køster Fogelberg. Stillingen er placeret i vores Fundraising Tech team, hvor ansvaret for tech, data og analyse ligger, men du kommer til at samarbejde med hele fundraisingafdelingen – og resten af kontoret.
Jobbet er en deltidsstilling på 12 timer/uge, evt. mere. Arbejdsstedet er Læger uden Grænsers kontor på Strandlodsvej 44, København S.
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte CRM & Data Manager, Tina Køster Fogelberg, på tf@copenhagen.msf.org

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Læger uden Grænser er meget omkostningsbevidste og ikke lønførende. Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i forhold til Læger uden Grænsers gældende lønramme.
Indsend din ansøgning
og dit CV
til
senest søndag den 6. september 2026, ved at følge linket og trykke på "apply" knappen.
Ønsket tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Om Læger uden Grænser

Læger uden Grænser (MSF) er en privat, international humanitær organisation, der yder akut lægehjælp til mennesker, som er truet af katastrofer, konflikter og epidemier, eller som ikke har adgang til et sundhedsvæsen. Vi hjælper hvert år millioner af mennesker verden over. Vi hjælper, hvor behovet er størst. Uanset hvem vores patienter er, og hvor de kommer fra. Vi værner om vores neutralitet og uafhængighed, men fortæller om de forhold, vi er vidne til, for at forbedre patienternes vilkår. I 1999 modtog vi Nobels Fredspris som en anerkendelse af vores arbejde.
Hos Læger uden Grænser ønsker vi en rummelig og inkluderende kultur med plads til forskellighed på arbejdspladsen. Vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge stillingen.
